transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Welcome to home broadband infrastructure and engineer scheduling. My name is Dominic. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Dominic. I am calling to arrange an urgent engineering job to relocate our broadband master telephone socket. We are currently having extensive renovation work done in our front hallway, and our builder needs to knock down a stud partition wall where the Openreach master socket is currently mounted. We need the master socket moved fifteen metres into our rear home office study room!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into booking an internal socket relocation appointment for you. Before we query the Openreach engineering schedule, may I please verify your full billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the billing address is 74 Victoria Park Road, Manchester, M14 5QL. And my security question answer is my place of birth, Birmingham.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that verifies the subscriber account. What is your landline telephone number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone number is 0161 496 0914. Dominic, the builders are on site with sledgehammers right now and their structural engineer told me that if that partition wall isn't demolished by tomorrow noon, the entire project will stall, incurring four hundred pounds a day in contractor penalty fees! If the builders accidentally sever the incoming underground copper drop-cable with a circular saw while cutting out timber frames, our entire household and home business internet will be completely severed for weeks! I am under extreme stress to get this socket moved immediately!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the acute pressure of having structural builders on site with strict deadlines and contractor delay penalties, and the risk of severing incoming copper cables during demolition is very stressful, so let us secure an Openreach specialist wiring engineer appointment right away to keep your project safely on track.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Dominic, I really appreciate you understanding the urgency of the building work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the Openreach Equinox B2B portal to verify line demarcation boundaries and copper pair entry points.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What do the Openreach network records show for our property?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The exchange record shows an underground lead-in duct terminating on an external grey junction box on your front exterior wall.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the black drop-wire enters from the pavement and goes into that grey box on the outside wall.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Openreach is an independent statutory network entity; S-Net has zero control or liability over where engineering contractors route internal cables or drill holes through domestic masonry.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We pay S-Net every month! You are our service provider and book the engineer! You cannot completely wash your hands of how the engineer does the job!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Openreach standard internal shift tariff covers rerouting up to thirty metres of internal CW1308 white telephone cabling.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fifteen metres is well within thirty metres, so that should be covered by the standard shift rate.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The statutory Openreach master socket relocation fee is a fixed charge of one hundred and thirty pounds including value added tax.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: One hundred and thirty pounds is completely fine. When is the earliest available appointment date?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The earliest available Openreach internal wiring slot is tomorrow morning between eight o'clock and one o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tomorrow between eight and one is perfect because our builder is on site to show the engineer the route under the floorboards.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you had planned your hallway redecoration properly beforehand, you wouldn't be wasting our time with emergency wiring relocations.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That was an astonishingly arrogant and unprofessional comment! Redecoration plans change during structural renovations! Keep your insulting personal opinions to yourself and process the booking!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am populating the engineer dispatch order in the Equinox portal under order reference OR-WIR-882914.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Order reference OR-WIR-882914 is noted.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineer work order includes removal of the old hallway faceplate and installation of a new NTE5C master socket in the study room.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will the engineer supply the brand-new NTE5C faceplate with the built-in VDSL filter?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Openreach engineers carry genuine Master Socket 5C units with integrated RF choke filtering on all wiring vans.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will give us optimal broadband speeds in the study room.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Direct master socket connection eliminates line attenuation caused by legacy daisy-chained extension wires.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The study room is where my main PC and network storage are located, so having the Hub there is ideal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Connecting the broadband Hub directly to the incoming master socket provides the cleanest signal-to-noise ratio.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will the engineer test the sync speed on his hand-held tester before he leaves?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineer conducts an automated PQD copper qualification test and submits synch metrics to the network gate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me confidence the line will be working before the builders seal the flooring.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously testing loop attenuation before sub-floor concealment prevents secondary diagnostic visits.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Exactly. I want to make sure it's done right the first time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the primary mobile contact number for engineer arrival SMS messages tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile contact number is 07700 900725.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have designated 07700 900725 for the engineer's pre-visit telephone call.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The builder and I will both be on site from seven-thirty AM onwards.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineer will call approximately twenty minutes prior to arriving at the property.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Twenty minutes warning is plenty of time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the billing arrangement for the one hundred and thirty pound socket relocation charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will that be billed on our regular monthly invoice or paid to the engineer directly?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Openreach engineers never accept cash or card payments on site; the one hundred and thirty pounds appears as a one-off item on your next monthly S-Net invoice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is convenient as it goes through our registered Direct Debit automatically.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The invoice will detail the charge under 'Specialist Internal Socket Relocation Fee'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our accountant can easily file that as a home office improvement expense.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also check whether your broadband router Hub requires an extended RJ11 DSL lead or standard Cat6 patch cable for the study desk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Since the master socket will be right next to my desk, a standard one-metre cable is all we need.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Shorter DSL patch leads minimize radio interference pickup from nearby desktop peripherals.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That keeps cable clutter to a minimum as well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check whether any existing analogue landline telephone handsets will be plugged into the relocated socket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We use a Panasonic digital cordless base station plugged into the telephone port, with handsets around the house.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The DECT cordless base station will broadcast clear voice signal across all floors from the study.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: DECT cordless range easily covers the garden and all upstairs bedrooms.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your account email address to confirm receipt of the engineer dispatch confirmation notice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have already received the automated booking email with tomorrow morning's slot.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the Openreach wiring shift booking reference is OR-WIR-882914 scheduled for tomorrow morning between eight AM and one PM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, OR-WIR-882914 tomorrow between eight and one. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The booking is locked into the national Openreach workforce management system.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that takes a huge weight off my mind with our builders.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am pleased we have scheduled the socket relocation to protect your broadband wiring during the renovation work. Have I answered all of your questions and completely resolved your issue today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes Dominic, you have answered all of my questions and sorted out the booking completely. Thank you very much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a wonderful day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Dominic, thank you.
